core.title: 18 inch Whisk Appliance Pull, First Impressions FII-WHISK

text.description_html:
First Impressions 18 Inch Whisk Appliance Pull

This original design appliance pull is a popular choice for refrigerators and freezers. This 18" high Whisk pull is from the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International, famous for high quality innovational appliance pull designs.

They are sure to be a hit at your next gathering after you install them on your Sub Zero refrigerator and freezer.

Packaged standard with mounting screws for a refrigerator/appliance door panels. For other doors optional Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other).

*Sold individually*
